credit.title: Underwater recording of aquatic movement, bubbles and drops.
credit.author: felix.blume

species: Real underwater recording (hydrophone) of air bubbles bubbling up in a river at Praia do Sono, Brazil, used for the cave fish (cave fish make no well-known sound)
note: Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
